name: ApeStaking NFT ownership accounting
summary: ApeStaking's deposit path could attribute an already-staked NFT position and caller-supplied stake amounts to a temporary NFT holder without receiving corresponding ApeCoin, allowing repeated withdrawApeCoin calls to drain APE and support cross-market borrowing.
notes: The proxy's sole pre-exploit Upgraded event selected the defect-bearing implementation during proxy deployment.

Assets extracted into attacker-controlled accounts across the successful Pawnfi exploit calls from block 17496620 through 17496648, after APE flash-loan repayment. ETH is the gross protocol payout before gas; token amounts are final attacker balances. Values use DefiLlama's closest incident-time observations and stablecoin par.
DefiLlama's closest APE observation is about 2.7 hours before the first exploit transaction; ETH and WBTC observations are within about one minute.
